name: TransTeleCom (TTK)
verdict: TransTeleCom is 99.99% owned by OAO RZD (Russian Railways), which is wholly owned by the Russian Federation.
note: Partner of FC Lokomotiv; the ТТК logo sits on the shorts of the 2026-27 home kit (club partners page and the club's own 16 Sep 2026 match photos). Propose severe: controlled by state-owned RZD; the Russian Federation has been at war with Ukraine since February 2022.
